    • requestAllCardReaders

      public static java.lang.Object requestAllCardReaders()

      an array of GinaServiceStub.CardReader if request was successful, otherwise Message with received error details

    • getCardTokenACard

      public java.lang.Object getCardTokenACard​(java.lang.String cardReaderId, java.lang.String vpnr, java.lang.String password)
      This method requests signature token of A-Card.
      Parameters:
      cardReaderId - ID of card reader where needed card is inserted
      vpnr - contract partner number of A-Card
      password - PIN for authenticate with A-card
      Returns:
      signature token if request was successful, otherwise Message with received error details

    • getErrorMessageFromJson

      public Message getErrorMessageFromJson​(org.json.JSONObject jo, int requestStatus)
      This method extracts error details of received JSONObject in following format: 
       
     "code": "3",
     "detailCode": "CA-03002",
     "text": "Der Wert der eingegebenen Identifikationsnummer (PIN) ist ungültig."
      Parameters:
      jo - received JSON
      requestStatus - HTTP request status
      Returns:
      Message with extracted details and passed request status

    • getCardTokenECard

      public java.lang.Object getCardTokenECard​(java.lang.String cardReaderId, java.lang.String ssno, java.lang.String vpnr)
      This method requests signature token of e-Card.
      Parameters:
      cardReaderId - ID of card reader
      ssno - social security number of patient whose e-Card is inserted into selected card reader
      vpnr - contract partner number of Admin-Card
      Returns:
      signature token if request was successful, otherwise Message with received error details

    • extractResult

      public java.lang.Object extractResult​(com.mashape.unirest.http.HttpResponse<java.lang.String> response, java.lang.Class<?> expectedClass)
      This method extracts the received response of GINO status query.
      Parameters:
      response - received answer
      expectedClass - expected type of answer, Card to retrieve card details and String to retrieve signature token of card are supported.
      Returns:
      an instance of the expected class if the request was successful, otherwise Message with received error details

    • getCardData

      public java.lang.Object getCardData​(java.lang.String cardReaderId)
      This method requests card details such as number of the card or the name of card owner.
      Parameters:
      cardReaderId - ID of the card reader in which required card is inserted.
      Returns:
      Card if the request was successful, otherwise Message with received error details
